components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The standard forest-green paper-strip action for major calls to action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-block; border:0; background:var(--green, #0b5d4b); color:var(--paper, #f7f9f8); padding:16px 28px; font-family:"Pilcrow Rounded", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-weight:700; clip-path:polygon(10% 0,100% 0,90% 100%,0 100%); cursor:pointer; transition:transform .2s ease-out, background .2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); background:var(--green-dark, #032b24); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:4px solid var(--yellow, #f5bd2f); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Light Button
components.description: A reversed action for use on Association Green or other dark forest surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-light { display:inline-block; border:0; background:var(--paper, #f7f9f8); color:var(--green-dark, #032b24); padding:16px 28px; font-family:"Pilcrow Rounded", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-weight:700; clip-path:polygon(10% 0,100% 0,90% 100%,0 100%); cursor:pointer; transition:transform .2s ease-out, background .2s ease-out; } .ds-btn-light:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); background:var(--paper-deep, #e7f0eb); } .ds-btn-light:focus-visible { outline:4px solid var(--yellow, #f5bd2f); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-light:active { transform:translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Contact Navigation Tab
components.description: The clipped navigation action that distinguishes contact from ordinary anchor links.
components.html: ΣχολείοΣύλλογοςΕπικοινωνία
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; color:var(--ink, #073f34); font-family:"Pilcrow Rounded", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-weight:500; } .ds-nav a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none; text-underline-offset:.2em; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:4px solid var(--yellow, #f5bd2f); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-nav-action { background:var(--green, #0b5d4b); color:var(--paper, #f7f9f8) !important; padding:12px 24px; clip-path:polygon(12% 0,100% 0,88% 100%,0 100%); }

components.name: Folder Tab
components.description: An overlapping construction-paper navigation sheet with a labeled trapezoid tab.
components.css: .ds-folder-tab { position:relative; display:block; width:min(520px, 88vw); height:150px; margin-top:38px; background:var(--coral, #f06455); color:var(--green-dark, #032b24); text-decoration:none; font-family:"Pilcrow Rounded", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; font-weight:700; } .ds-folder-tab::before { content:""; position:absolute; top:-38px; left:48%; width:180px; height:42px; background:inherit; clip-path:polygon(12% 0,88% 0,100% 100%,0 100%); } .ds-folder-tab span { position:absolute; z-index:1; top:-32px; left:52%; } .ds-folder-tab:hover { background:var(--yellow, #f5bd2f); } .ds-folder-tab:focus-visible { outline:4px solid var(--yellow, #f5bd2f); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Announcement Row
components.description: The live index item that drives the announcement image preview and carries verified or sample status.
components.css: .ds-news-row { width:100%; display:grid; grid-template-columns:70px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:20px; padding:22px 0; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid rgba(7,63,52,.28); background:var(--yellow, #f5bd2f); color:var(--ink, #073f34); text-align:left; font-family:"Pilcrow Rounded", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity .24s ease-out, transform .24s ease-out; } .ds-news-row:hover, .ds-news-row:focus-visible, .ds-news-row[aria-pressed="true"] { transform:translateX(10px); } .ds-news-row:focus-visible { outline:4px solid var(--yellow, #f5bd2f); outline-offset:4px; box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--green-dark, #032b24); } .ds-news-row strong, .ds-news-row small { display:block; } .ds-news-row small { margin-top:4px; font-size:.875rem; line-height:1.35; } .ds-news-row time { font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:700; } .ds-news-thumb { width:64px; height:64px; background:var(--blue, #36a8d8); clip-path:polygon(50% 0,100% 62%,50% 100%,0 62%); }

components.name: Leaf Image Frame
components.description: The signature pointed image silhouette used for previews and community artwork.
components.css: .ds-leaf-frame { position:relative; width:min(420px, 86vw); aspect-ratio:1; margin:0; overflow:hidden; background:var(--green, #0b5d4b); clip-path:polygon(50% 0,96% 40%,82% 84%,50% 100%,18% 84%,4% 40%); } .ds-leaf-art { position:relative; width:100%; height:100%; background:var(--blue, #36a8d8); } .ds-leaf-art::before { content:""; position:absolute; inset:38% 0 0; background:var(--paper-deep, #e7f0eb); clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 24%,100% 100%,0 100%); } .ds-leaf-art::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:64% 0 0; background:var(--coral, #f06455); clip-path:polygon(0 18%,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%); } .ds-leaf-frame figcaption { position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:8%; transform:translateX(-50%); padding:6px 10px; background:var(--paper, #f7f9f8); color:var(--green-dark, #032b24); white-space:nowrap; font:700 .8125rem/1.35 "Pilcrow Rounded", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; } .ds-leaf-frame:focus-within { outline:4px solid var(--yellow, #f5bd2f); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A square paper field with dark ink border and a high-visibility external focus state.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-email">Email</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-email" type="email" placeholder="onoma@example.gr">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:6px; color:var(--green-dark, #032b24); font:700 .875rem/1.35 "Pilcrow Rounded", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; } .ds-field { width:100%; border:2px solid var(--green-dark, #032b24); border-radius:0; background:var(--paper, #f7f9f8); color:var(--ink, #073f34); padding:13px 14px; font:400 1.0625rem/1.55 "Pilcrow Rounded", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; caret-color:var(--coral, #f06455); } .ds-field:hover { background:var(--paper-deep, #e7f0eb); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:4px solid var(--yellow, #f5bd2f); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview:
The system feels like a school noticeboard assembled by hand at the edge of Kryoneri's forest: useful first, warm without sentimentality, and tactile without pretending to be physical paper. Cool paper grounds deep green ink while blue, yellow, coral, and sage behave like a small set of construction-paper sheets.

Its signature is a pointed leaf geometry repeated with discipline across the wordmark, image masks, navigation tabs, controls, and small picture windows. The stacked-folder composition is a particularly expressive use of the system, while the underlying rules—flat color, clipped silhouettes, oversized rounded type, and honest content labeling—remain reusable on quieter pages.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-flat color fields with crisp cut edges rather than conventional rounded cards.
One pointed leaf motif, scaled from icon to image frame.
Oversized Pilcrow Rounded headlines paired with calm, readable body copy.
Bright construction-paper accents anchored by forest green and cool paper.
Explicit labels distinguish verified facts, sample announcements, and unconfirmed association content.

rules.name: The Construction-Paper Rule
rules.body: Use each accent as one decisive sheet or tab; do not blend the palette into gradients.

rules.name: The Yellow Focus Rule
rules.body: Keyboard focus is always a four-pixel Notice Yellow outline with a four-pixel offset, including on already-yellow sections where a dark supporting edge may be added for contrast.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Keep every typographic role in Pilcrow Rounded; hierarchy is created through scale, weight, measure, and leading.

rules.name: The Tight-Headline Rule
rules.body: Display and section headlines use close leading and negative tracking, but body copy never inherits those settings.

rules.name: The Wide-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Use the shared maximum canvas and fluid gutter for alignment, then break out only when a section is intentionally a full color sheet.

rules.name: The Cut-Paper Depth Rule
rules.body: Create depth with overlap, cropping, scale, and color adjacency; do not add soft ambient shadows to ordinary surfaces.

rules.name: The One-Motif Rule
rules.body: Reuse the pointed leaf silhouette at different scales; do not introduce unrelated blobs, pills, circles, or decorative squiggles.

rules.name: The Crisp-Cut Rule
rules.body: Clipped shapes have hard edges and flat fills. Border radii remain zero.

dos: Do treat the page as assembled sheets: use large color fields, overlaps, and clipped edges to build hierarchy.
Do preserve high contrast and the visible Notice Yellow focus treatment on every interactive element.
Do keep announcement rows, folder tabs, and mobile navigation operable by keyboard and touch.
Do label sample announcements and unverified association information in plain language at the point where it appears.
Do use original paper-cut imagery with truthful alt text that distinguishes illustration from documentary photography.
donts: Don't replace the cut-paper system with rounded white cards, glass panels, gradients, or generic soft shadows.
Don't scatter all accent colors inside one small component; give each sheet or state one clear color role.
Don't add a second decorative motif or novelty typeface beside the pointed leaf and Pilcrow Rounded.
Don't present board members, events, association contact details, or institutional claims as verified until the content is confirmed.
Don't hide the live announcement preview or its selected state on small screens; reflow it above the index instead.
